facts.fact: Comores Droit reports that at the 14 August 2026 restitution in Moroni the country was said to hold a legal framework, technical studies, a national mapping of civil registration centres and a costed modernisation plan for its civil registration system.
facts.system: AMECC II (projet d'appui à la modernisation de l'état civil)

facts.fact: The advances so far were financed by the French embassy and UNICEF through AMECC II, and national institutions validated a residual financing need of EUR 9,009,900 to implement the reform, according to the UNICEF-recruited consultant's presentation of 14 August 2026.
facts.system: AMECC II (projet d'appui à la modernisation de l'état civil)

facts.fact: A UNICEF-recruited consultant ran a resource-mobilisation mission from 30 July to 16 August 2026 and presented its first results on 14 August 2026, with an international mobilisation mission and a partners' conference to follow; the reform is described as still to pass from preparation to large-scale implementation.
